component.name: Reveal the Dream
component.summary: Uncover a photo of your goal, one check-in at a time

description.p: Pick a photo of a goal you are working toward. It starts covered, divided into one piece per day of your journey. Each daily check-in uncovers one more piece, until the whole photo shows.
Miss a day and nothing resets. That day's piece stays covered and the next days keep opening.

On Linux you get a mini window that stays above your other windows and a daily reminder in your desktop's notifications. Free to use. Premium adds sync with iPhone, Mac, Windows and Android, several journeys at once, rest days and App Lock.
First Linux release, with a short tour, the mini window, daily reminders and Premium Lifetime.
